notes: *even* is marked added under rule 16's limit: the verse writes no object marker on כֻּלָּהּ, so nothing licenses the appositional word, and rule 42's reasoning forbids folding it into a neighbouring unit.
כְּשִׂמְחָתְךָ is read under rules 52 and 18: the preposition takes *As*, the noun carries the lexeme *rejoice* with the supplied *didst*, and the suffix takes the subject pronoun.
כֻּלָּהּ follows rule 19's pronominal-rectum clause: כֹּל takes only *all* and the suffix takes the whole *of it*, headed on the pronoun.
